description: Detect visual scene cuts / shot boundaries in the video using ffmpeg's scene-change filter. Useful for videos without dialogue or transcripts (screen recordings, silent footage, music videos). Set `to_chapters: true` to immediately install the detected scenes as navigable chapters on the playing file.

file.description: Optional video file path; defaults to the playing file

max_scenes.description: Maximum number of scenes to return (1-100, default 20)

threshold.description: Scene change sensitivity threshold between 0.05 and 0.95 (default 0.3; lower detects more subtle cuts)

to_chapters.description: Apply detected scenes as virtual chapters on the playing file

name: detect_scenes
